title: 第3章 迷茫第4章 五灵根
slug: 修仙所有人都以为她背景很强
lines: 这时，她才看清手中的哪里是什么枯木，那分明是一支青翠通透的竹萧。
不远处的鬼影似乎正是惧怕这支竹萧，才不敢上前，只在原地愤恨扭曲。
巫未央愣了一下，不敢轻举妄动。
双方对峙许久，巫未央的心跳总算一点点恢复平静，没了重重的心跳声，她耳边忽然多了很多嘈杂的声音。
像是这些鬼影在尖叫哀嚎以及怒吼。
她手抖了一下，竹萧也晃了一下，鬼影欻欻地后退了几丈。
巫未央像是发现了什么，站起身试探地举着玉箫往前，鬼影果然继续后退。
她眨了眨大眼睛，微微一笑，举着竹箫选了个方向便冲了过去。
鬼影尖叫着闪躲，给巫未央让出了一条路。
局势瞬间反转，猎手猎物身份互换。
但巫未央可没有消灭这些鬼影的想法，她还没那么冲动上头，她只是想离开。
月亮已经彻底消失不见，天空也开始明亮，但不知道是不是深谷之中鬼影众多，阴气太浓，视线光亮不了多少。
一路上，巫未央看见了许多尸体，这些尸体无一不腐烂血腥，她也从一开始吓到脸色苍白呕吐不止到最后的麻木，她甚至有点想翻翻那些尸体，有没有带吃的。
她又累又痛又困又饿，已经快坚持不住了。
但巫未央不想死，她想活，她一定要走出这里。
乌溜溜的眼眸望向天空，满是倔强。
日出东方，攀上半空，炙烤了一番大地，便又西沉。
而被斜阳铺上一层红纱的平林村，一片死寂。
突然，一道小小的身影缓慢地走入村中，望着那焚烧过后只剩下些许残骸的灰堆，陷入了呆愣。
巫未央历尽千辛万苦从深谷中爬出，一路沿着溪边寻回，这才赶在天黑之前走了回来。
她看着那明显是骨灰的灰堆，心中没有什么感想，她真的太累了，如若不是求生意志坚强，她早倒在了路上。
竹萧在她手中变成了拐杖，因为它足有大半个巫未央长，顺手之下就成了拐杖。
撑着竹萧，巫未央回了家。
或许是当时她不在家，妖狼没有嗅到血肉气息，也就没有来到她家，家里还好好的。
巫未央推开院门，院子里只有一座小小的木房，木房屋檐下面搭了个灶台，这就是她家的厨房。
再往屋里看，只有一套方桌方椅，和一张大木床。
巫未央先是走到灶台，翻出了两个饼子就狼吞虎咽起来，饼子是她之前做的干粮，这么多天也还没坏，不过有点太干巴了，她使劲吞了几口，才从一旁的水缸里舀了碗水配着吃。
吃完东西，巫未央什么也不管了，进了屋就躺下，沉沉睡去，或许称为昏迷更为合适。
等她再次醒来时，外面阳光明媚，显然已经是大白天了。
巫未央浑身不舒服，背后却没有多疼，她伸手摸了摸，只摸到了浅浅的凸起，竟像是结痂了。
她有些诧异，就算当时妖狼抓得不深，可是被水泡了好几天，醒来时又那么痛，现在竟然好了。
虽然相当不可思议，但巫未央即使再早慧也不可能想明白其中玄机。
content_en:
Only then did she see clearly what kind of dead wood was in her hand. It was clearly a green and transparent bamboo shoot.
The ghost figure not far away seemed to be afraid of this bamboo Xiao, so it didn't dare to step forward, and just stayed in place and twisted in anger.
Wu Weiyang was stunned for a moment, not daring to act rashly.
The two sides faced off for a long time, and Wu Weiyang's heartbeat finally returned to calm little by little. The heavy heartbeat stopped, and there were suddenly a lot of noisy sounds in her ears.
It was like these ghost figures were screaming, wailing, and roaring.
Her hand trembled, the bamboo Xiao also swayed, and the ghostly figure stepped back a few feet.
Wu Weiyang seemed to have discovered something. He stood up and tentatively held up the jade flute and moved forward. As expected, the ghost continued to retreat.
She blinked her big eyes, smiled slightly, picked a direction with her bamboo flute and rushed over.
The ghost screamed and dodged, making way for Wu Weiyang.
The situation is reversed in an instant, and the identities of the hunter and the prey are swapped.
But Wu Weiyang had no idea of ​​​​eliminating these ghosts. She was not so impulsive, she just wanted to leave.
The moon has completely disappeared, and the sky has begun to become brighter, but I don't know if there are many ghosts in the deep valley and the gloom is too strong, so there is not much light in the sight.
Along the way, Wu Weiyang saw many corpses, all of which were rotten and bloody. She was so frightened that she turned pale from the beginning and vomited until she became numb at the end. She even wanted to look through those corpses to see if she had anything to eat.
She was tired, sore, sleepy, and hungry, and could hardly hold on any longer.
But Wu Weiyang didn't want to die, she wanted to live, and she had to get out of here.
His dark eyes looked to the sky, full of stubbornness.
The sun rises in the east, climbs into the sky, scorches the earth, and then sets in the west.
However, Pinglin Village, which was covered with a layer of red gauze under the setting sun, was completely silent.
Suddenly, a small figure slowly walked into the village, looking at the ash pile with only some remains after the burning, and fell into a daze.
Wu Weiyang went through all kinds of hardships to climb out of the deep valley and found his way back along the stream, and then returned before dark.
She looked at the pile of ashes that was obviously ashes and had no thoughts in her heart. She was really too tired. If she hadn't had a strong will to survive, she would have collapsed on the road.
The bamboo Xiao turned into a crutch in her hands, because it was more than half the length of Wu Weiyang, so it turned into a crutch.
Holding Zhu Xiao, Wu Weiyang returned home.
Perhaps she was not at home at the time, and the demon wolf did not smell the scent of flesh and blood, so it did not come to her house. The house was still fine.
Wu Weiyang opened the courtyard door. There was only a small wooden house in the courtyard. There was a stove under the eaves of the wooden house. This was her kitchen.
Looking further into the room, there is only a set of square tables and chairs, and a large wooden bed.
Wu Weiyang first walked to the stove, pulled out two pancakes and wolfed them down. The pancakes were dry food she had made before. They had not gone bad after so many days, but they were a bit too dry. She swallowed a few mouthfuls, and then scooped a bowl of water from the water tank on the side to go with it.
After eating, Wu Weiyang didn't care about anything. After entering the room, he lay down and fell into a deep sleep. Perhaps it was more appropriately called a coma.
When she woke up again, the sun was shining brightly outside and it was obviously broad daylight.
Wu Weiyang felt uncomfortable all over, but her back didn't hurt much. She reached out and touched it, only to feel a shallow bump, which seemed to be a scab.
She was a little surprised. Even though the demon wolf didn't scratch her deeply at that time, she was soaked in water for several days and was in so much pain when she woke up. Now she was actually better.
Although it is quite incredible, no matter how precocious Wu Weiyang is, he cannot figure out the mystery.
